vars.label: Road distance to a supermarket (estimate, km)
vars.ref: Estimated by the observatory: road distance over the OpenStreetMap road graph (roads.bin) from each 2020 Census block with residents to the nearest point of the kind, averaged over residents (essentials.py)
vars.definition: The average road distance from where the area's residents live to the nearest supermarket, in kilometers, each 2020 Census block weighted by its residents. Supermarkets are Overture's grocery and warehouse-club places whose name is a supermarket's ("supermercado", "supermarket" or a supermarket chain), plus Walmart, Costco and Sam's Club, and OpenStreetMap's supermarkets that Overture lacks; corner stores (colmados) are left out. An estimate: distance along the mapped roads in either direction, not a driving route or a time. The places come from a directory, so a shop that closed may still be counted and one that opened may be missing. Blocks with no road within 2 km, or no road to any place of the kind, are left out.

vars.label: Road distance to a food store (supermarket or colmado) (estimate, km)
vars.ref: Estimated by the observatory: road distance over the OpenStreetMap road graph (roads.bin) from each 2020 Census block with residents to the nearest point of the kind, averaged over residents (essentials.py)
vars.definition: The average road distance from where the area's residents live to the nearest food store (supermarket or colmado), in kilometers, each 2020 Census block weighted by its residents. Food stores are every place in Overture's grocery categories, colmados (corner stores) included, and the supermarkets above. In small towns the nearest food store is often a colmado or a 'super colmado' that the supermarket rule leaves out. An estimate: distance along the mapped roads in either direction, not a driving route or a time. The places come from a directory, so a shop that closed may still be counted and one that opened may be missing. Blocks with no road within 2 km, or no road to any place of the kind, are left out.
